gold.question: Regarding PV-2-1 on the P&ID: The valve leaks through when shut. Is it the seat ring or the plug seal, and how do I check?

candidate: Not in the documents. The documents don't identify which part is leaking or provide a diagnostic/checking procedure, so that part of the question is not stated. What the PV-2-1 datasheet (Fisher ET) does say: the valve's shutoff is achieved by the valve plug seal ring being forced (by a backup ring or spring-loading) against the cage, with seat rings as the seating parts. Shutoff is rated per ANSI/FCI 70-2 / IEC 60534-4: Class IV is standard with metal seating, Class V/VI are optional (Class V requires spring-loaded seal ring, radius-seat plug and wide-bevel seat ring), and TSO trim is factory tested to no leakage at shipment (shutoff class V, water test medium). If the valve was ordered with TSO or Class V/VI trim, leakage when shut would indicate those sealing parts (plug seal ring and/or seat ring) are not performing to that rating, but the datasheet does not say how to determine which one is at fault.
